Goods Receipt

Goods receipt footers are customizable text sections that appear at the bottom of your goods receipts, providing important information about receiving procedures and documentation requirements.

You can create multiple footer templates to accommodate different types of deliveries, suppliers, or warehouse procedures.

Purpose

Footers help standardize your receiving documentation by including consistent information on every goods receipt.

Each footer template can be tailored for specific scenarios, such as different product categories, supplier requirements, or warehouse locations.

This table displays all your goods receipt footer templates. Each row represents a different footer that can be selected when creating goods receipts.

Common Footer Content

Typical information included in goods receipt footers:

• Inspection requirements - Quality control procedures and acceptance criteria

• Storage instructions - Temperature requirements, handling precautions, or shelf life information

• Discrepancy procedures - Steps to follow when received quantities or conditions don't match the purchase order

• Receiving notes - Special instructions for warehouse staff or acknowledgment statements

Managing Templates

To create a new footer template, click the New Footer button below the table.

Give each footer a descriptive name that clearly indicates its purpose, such as 'Perishable Goods Receipt', 'Equipment Delivery', or 'Chemical Materials Handling'.

When creating a goods receipt, you'll be able to select from your available footer templates, ensuring the appropriate information appears on each document.
